# The Ars Goetia — 72 demon gods

Demons are a **race** (NPCs and enemies, never playable unless a character is changed
into one) who **revere demon gods** — these 72. Authored from the Lesser Key of
Solomon (public domain), each carrying its real rank, legion count, described form
and described powers, mapped onto the casino register.

**Command is not reverence** (Q-59): a legion bound by force is not a congregation,
which is why every goetic spirit sits at influence 1 despite commanding legions.
They are powerful and poor — which is exactly why they are at a casino.
